The '''Shiwal sector''' was a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]] and the [[Tarchalia system/Legends|Tarchalia]] and [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or systems]]. The Tarchalia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Tarchalian gazelle]]s, and the Walin'or system was the origin point of the [[Walin'or cell]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. System VV-99-7JE-2N71 contained an unstable [[Star/Legends|star]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by sixteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including one that had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was home to various life forms. The system was surveyed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]], and at another point, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Kragg's Fury]]'' was left adrift there.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the discovery of the ''Kragg's Fury'' led to an [[Expedition to System VV-99-7JE-2N71|expedition]] to the system, during which the vessel self-destructed. At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Lu'daal-ud]] captured high-security [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] of the Rebel Alliance, thus endangering its operations in the Shiwal [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The sector was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[12 ABY/Legends|ten years]] later, when the New Republic [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|warship]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] passed through it as part of a [[Orinda campaign|military campaign]] against the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
[[File:Shiwal_sector.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Shiwal sector and its surroundings]]
The Shiwal [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Luuq sector/Legends|Luuq sector]] [[spinward]], the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel]], [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra]], and [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and the [[Homon sector/Legends|Homon sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction.<ref name="Mid Rim" /> The sector also formed a part of the Mid Rim's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] border with the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Corpheli sector/Legends|Corpheli]], [[Ehosiq sector/Legends|Ehosiq]], and [[Fellwe sector/Legends|Fellwe sectors]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The westernmost portion of the Shiwal sector contained the [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]],<ref name="EGTW" /> whereas the [[Tarchalia system/Legends|Tarchalia system]] and [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]] were situated in the sector's more eastward parts.<ref name="Eastward">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]] in grid square L-7 as part of the Shiwal [[Sector/Legends|sector]], with ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' depicting that portion of the sector&mdash;also including the [[Tarchalia system/Legends|Tarchalia system]]&mdash;as lying more eastward than the area containing the [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]].</ref> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] traveled through the Walin'or [[Star system/Legends|system]], linking it to the [[Belukat system/Legends|Belukat system]] of the Corpheli sector and the Hollan sector's [[Mapuzo system/Legends|Mapuzo system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
[[File:Ludaalud-AIR.png|thumb|left|250px|The bounty hunter Lu'daal-ud (pictured) endangered the operations of Rebel Alliance agents in the Shiwal sector.]]
The Shiwal sector's Walin'or system was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Tarchalian gazelle]] and the [[Walin'or cell]]|system=[[Tarchalia system/Legends|Tarchalia system]] and [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]], respectively|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Walin'or cell]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Approximately five [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]] before<ref name="AIR" /> some point in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2ABY">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Alliance agent [[Patel Odfath]] had in his possession several high-security [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] that contained details regarding the operations of Alliance cells in the Shiwal sector as well as the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]]<ref name="AIR" /> of the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="EGTW" />

At that time, Odfath was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Lu'daal-ud]], whom the Alliance believed had kept the datafiles. The possibility that Lu'daal-ud would then sell the files to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was estimated by the Alliance to endanger the lives of almost a thousand operatives active in the region ranging from the Walin'or cell to the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost]]<ref name="AIR" /> in the Expansion Region,<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> and the [[SecuriDex]] datafile on Lu'daal-ud compiled by the Alliance [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] noted that the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] posed a high threat level to Rebel operatives in the Shiwal sector.<ref name="AIR" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Shiwal sector was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the Walin'or system served as a stronghold of that state. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the New Republic [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] traveled through the Walin'or system as part of a [[Orinda campaign|military campaign]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Locations==
The Tarchalia system was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creatures known as [[Tarchalian gazelle]]s.<ref name="WS" /> The system fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a conflict fought from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

System VV-99-7JE-2N71 had a weak, [[Color/Legends|orange]]-yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] that was unstable and prone to highly intensive [[Solar flare/Legends|flaring]] and [[Gas/Legends|outgassing]]. The resulting activity of ion discharges in the system presented a hazard to visitors. The system's sun was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by sixteen [[Planet/Legends|planets]], nine of which were [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type worlds. The fourth planet had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was inhabited by various life forms. The system was surveyed by the Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]], who placed standard [[warning beacon]]s along the perimeter of the outer system to warn potential future arrivals of the instability of its star.<ref name="Journal7">{{JournalCite|7|Silent Fury}}</ref>

[[File:KraggsFury-Journal7.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The ''Kragg's Fury'' was adrift in System VV-99-7JE-2N71.]]
At another point, the ''[[Kragg's Fury]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hez Kragg]], ended up abandoned in System VV-99-7JE-2N71. The [[Treasure hunting/Legends|fortune hunter]] [[Sig Coven]] discovered the drifting ''Kragg's Fury'' during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the Galactic Empire. Coven informed the [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Jonas Durns]] about his find, and Durns in turn arranged for an [[Expedition to System VV-99-7JE-2N71|expedition]] to the system to confirm the starship's identity. Durns recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for transportation to the system, and the expedition ultimately boarded the ancient vessel and subsequently left it with a valuable chest. The ''Kragg's Fury'', however, self-destructed by flying into the system's star.<ref name="Journal7" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Allianceintelligencereports.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Shiwal sector was first mentioned in ''Alliance Intelligence Reports''.]]
The Shiwal sector was first mentioned in<ref name="AIR" /> the [[June]] [[1995]]<ref name="AIRDate">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 6]]</ref> [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> It was subsequently depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in "[https://web.archive.org/web/20120117150257/https://www.starwars.com/atlas/midrim/index.html Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," a [[2011]] feature of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to<ref name="MidRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/midrim/index.html|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> the [[2009]]<ref name="EAOC" /> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The map placed the sector in grid squares L-7, M-7, and L-8.<ref name="MidRimOriginal" />

The Online Companion also placed System VV-99-7JE-2N71 in the Shiwal sector,<ref name="EAOC" /> thereby [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] establishing that system's appearance in "[[Silent Fury]]"&mdash;a [[roleplaying game]] adventure outline authored by [[Tony Russo]] for use with ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' and published within the article "[[A Taste of Adventure]]" as part of the [[August]] 1995 [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine&mdash;as the de facto earliest appearance of the sector.<ref name="Journal7" /> Although the Online Companion placed the Tarchalia system in the Luuq sector,<ref name="EAOC" /> the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' instead depicted it as being part of the Shiwal sector,<ref name="EGTW" /> which is more consistent with the system's earlier depiction on a map within ''The Essential Atlas'' and which this article therefore treats as correct.<ref name="TEA" />
